desc:
Update Log:
-AI Expands, Manages its own Money, Political Power, and Manpower
-AI Engages in trading, building, and diplomacy on a deeper level
-AI Can colonize, core, and convert lands
-Holy Roman Empire added
-Event system added in with 10 events so far
-Game is mobile compatible now
-Time manipulation for private servers
-Added a basic tutorial for new players
-Admin tab expanded
-German skinpack added
-6 Nations got policies
-Added a small server queue
-Claim groups reworked
-Fixed Navy being broken
-Fixed inf battle bug

Grand strategy game set to and from 1444-1820

"C" to deselect all armies
"Q" to close notifications one by one
"Right Click" to max out gold in peace treaties
